evidence.quote: 只要行限造成太陰或太陽化忌，會使子宮成為雙忌夾制的宮位時

assessments.expressible_facts: Left helper in Life, right helper in Spouse/Xu; Ling/Huo flank Zi Life; Huo and Tian Tong share a palace; Tian Tong Hua Ji is explicitly asserted. Their source conditions and the case identity remain expressible.
assessments.typed_gap: Additional Tai Yin OR Tai Yang Hua Ji is a named alternative transformation bearer, not an unnamed star. No frozen alternatives-bearing SihuaMention exists.
assessments.scope_conclusion: Distinct invented scope IDs with the same full OR condition do not provide an exclusive/alternative link. A shortened condition such as 太陰 alone would omit the timing and double-Hua-Ji flanking prerequisite. No source-authored independent branch conditions were found in this chunk.
assessments.probe_interpretation: Two separately scoped positive objects can validate yet the structure does not encode OR; this is not an approved repair.
assessments.qualification: limited remains appropriate for the truncated opening, not for schema difficulty. Keep the full usable conditional paragraph.

evidence.quote: 若年干為陽時，天馬必定在寅宮或申宮，若年干為陰時，天馬一定在巳宮或亥宮。

assessments.expressible_facts: Tian Ma mention, year-stem polarity in source prose, four-location terminology, and one explicit grand-cycle mention are preserved. The yang and yin rules have separate source-authored conditions, so they can remain separate prose/evidence scopes without adding facts.
assessments.typed_gap: Within each of those two scopes the destination is still Yin OR Shen, or Si OR Hai. In addition, the registered palace participant type lacks earthly-branch location entities; inserting 寅宫 as a palace is rejected. This is not only an OR issue.
assessments.scope_conclusion: Splitting source-authored yang versus yin scopes is legitimate, but does not resolve the two alternatives inside either scope. Cannot infer functional Life/Body/etc palace from an earthly branch.

assessments.expressible_facts: Wu Qu/Tan Lang same-palace source rule and metal/wood explanations can be preserved without inventing a new causal relation; summaries retain qualifications about benefics, toil, malefics and non-inevitable early death.
assessments.typed_gap: The source independently introduces a Hua Lu rule and a Hua Ji rule, so these two rule scopes are separable. Within each, however, the transforming bearer is either Wu Qu or Tan Lang, not both. SihuaMention has a single star/null and no named choice set.
assessments.scope_conclusion: Original Hua Lu versus Hua Ji rule scopes are legitimate. Creating Wu Qu-only and Tan Lang-only conditions not actually stated as independent clauses would require a new branch interpretation; null/not_mentioned would falsely deny the explicitly named candidates. A different null reason preserves uncertainty but still drops the candidate set.
assessments.probe_interpretation: Validator acceptance of two positive objects with copied OR condition does not establish faithful typed OR semantics.
assessments.qualification: eligible with OCR uncertainty noted remains supportable; do not downgrade merely to avoid the binding problem.
